recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Reintroducing topic/context for this old tracker would contradict FHIR-13705 and FHIR-19511; future changes to these names or target types should be raised as new Patient Care work.
issue_request: FHIR-11381 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2. It asked to expand CommunicationRequest.encounter so a communication request could identify the resource that was the topic of the communication; the accepted resolution added CommunicationRequest.topic Reference(Any) and changed CommunicationRequest.encounter to CommunicationRequest.context Reference(Encounter | EpisodeOfCare).
initial_application: Commit c124072d7bc14dd9eea48ac1aaf530bcd31171a6 applied the issue on 2016-11-04 by changing the then-authoritative CommunicationRequest spreadsheet from encounter to topic 0..* Reference(Any) plus context 0..1 Reference(Encounter | EpisodeOfCare), both marked GF#11381.
additional_context: FHIR-13705 later removed CommunicationRequest.topic and replaced the concept with CommunicationRequest.about Reference(Any). FHIR-19511 later changed Patient Care context elements back to encounter 0..1 Reference(Encounter), with EpisodeOfCare support handled via extension work now outside core. Both related issues already have commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current active source defines CommunicationRequest.about with GF#11381,13705 committee notes and targetProfile Resource, defines CommunicationRequest.encounter with GF#11381 notes and targetProfile Encounter, exposes matching about and encounter search parameters, and has no active CommunicationRequest.topic element.

related_jiras.note: Published Patient Care decision removed CommunicationRequest.topic and replaced the resource-that-the-communication-is-about concept with CommunicationRequest.about.
Published Patient Care workflow decision changed context back to encounter 0..1 Reference(Encounter) and handled EpisodeOfCare support via extension.
